== Usage ==
The '''Grappling Hook''' has the model of a {{Item|Fishing Rod}}: casting it and reeling will fling the player towards the position of the bobber. It has a {{Green|2s}} cooldown. Using the '''Grappling Hook''' while it is on cooldown will display the following message:
{{Dialogue|&cWhoa! Slow down there!}}

The {{Item|Bat Person Armor}}'s {{AN|Bat Powers Activate!}} full set bonus removes the cooldown of the '''Grappling Hook''' and increases its power and range.

== Trivia ==
* By combining a {{Item|Grappling Hook}} with the {{Item|Spider's Boots}}'s {{AN|Double Jump}} ability, players can essentially fly.
** {{RN|Pig|Technoblade}} demonstrated this in his video "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vLLJAiII6p4 ''flying in skyblock'']".
* Due to the '''Grappling Hook'''{{'}}s cheap cost and early game accessibility, some aspects of the game are built with the assumption that the player has access to a '''Grappling Hook'''. 
** For example, many {{Item|Fairy Soul}}s are located in positions that require the use of mobility items such as the '''Grappling Hook''' to access.
* Unlike other mobility items such as {{Item|Aspect of the End}}, the '''Grappling Hook''' does not reset a player's downward speed, and as such will not prevent fall damage.
* Players can use a '''Grappling Hook''' while facing down or up to scale walls up to {{Green|5}} blocks at a time.
** Players can scale walls up to {{Green|11}} blocks with the {{Item|Bat Person Armor}} set bonus.
* Players can jump right before they grapple in order to increase the distance traveled.
* The '''Grappling Hook''' also appears as a gadget for Hypixel lobbies.
* As counter-intuitive as it sounds, players wishing to use the '''Grappling Hook''' and {{Item|Bat Person Armor}} who wish to cross long distances in the air should consider moving backwards while in the air before reeling their rod in, as the further the distance between the player and the bobber, the faster the player will move when they reel.
